name: Monuaf E-Commerce Mobile App
tagline: Cross-Platform Retail Shopping App (Grafton Flowers & Crunchy Qatar)
description: Production mobile application built with Flutter & Dart, powering customer shopping experiences for Grafton Flowers Qatar and Crunchy Cookies Qatar. Features dynamic inventory synchronization, real-time order status tracking, and offline-first cart state management.
challenges: Dynamic BOM Inventory Sync: Synchronized mobile store catalog with the dynamic raw ingredient stock pool, immediately disabling unfulfillable items upon ingredient depletion.
Event-Driven Telemetry Updates: Integrated WebSockets to push instant sub-second order status updates to customer mobile screens.
Network Fault Resilience: Built offline cart mutation queuing and idempotent order verification to handle intermittent mobile network connectivity.
architectureHighlights: BLoC clean layered architecture separating UI, domain logic, and data repositories.
Offline-first cart persistence using Hive/SQLite local encrypted storage.
Sub-second multi-store inventory synchronization across iOS and Android.

name: Flora POS & Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Platform
tagline: Enterprise Web Storefronts & Role-Based POS Dashboard
description: Flora is a premium, enterprise-grade E-Commerce and POS ecosystem designed specifically for high-volume floral and gift businesses. Features bilingual (English/Arabic) customer-facing web storefronts, role-based Admin POS & Order Prep Dashboards, and a highly scalable Django REST / ASGI backend. Multi-tenant monorepo architecture powers distinct brands (Grafton Flowers & Crunchy Qatar) from a single shared infrastructure.

techLayers.techs: Python 3.10+, Django 5.2+, Django REST Framework (DRF), Daphne
React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Redux Toolkit, RTK Query, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI
Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PNPM Monorepo
Docker, Nginx, WeasyPrint (PDF rendering), UV Package Manager

challenges: Complex Relational Recipe & Ingredient Modeling: Designed an inventory tracking system that calculates bouquet-level ingredient recipes (e.g. number of roses, ribbons, vases per arrangement) and dynamically decrements ingredient stock upon order creation to eliminate overselling.

Real-Time Cross-Role Synchronicity: Integrated Django Channels WebSockets and RTK Query cache invalidation so order updates from Customer Service immediately reflect on Florist preparation monitors and Stock Control screens.

Scalable Multi-Tenant Monorepo Configuration: Configured a PNPM monorepo workspace containing shared @monuaf/core packages (hooks, UI components, API clients) and Next.js Edge Middleware routing multiple domains (graftonflowers.com, crunchyqatar.com) to individual tenant apps.

Resilient Browser-Native PDF & Print Pipeline: Utilized WeasyPrint for dynamic compilation of custom gift message cards into PDFs and designed custom print CSS for reliable browser-native receipt and packaging label printing.

subsystems.title: 1. High-Performance E-Commerce Backend (Django REST Framework)
subsystems.description: Functions as the secure business engine.
points: Dual Auth & RBAC: Custom auth model supporting login via email or phone number with role-based access for Stock Control, Customer Service, Drivers, Florists, Administrators, and Customers.
Shadow Accounts: Built-in guest checkout flow with dynamic order-tracking links.
Inventory Control & Recipes: Tracks product-level raw ingredients (roses, ribbons, vases per bouquet) and dynamically reserves stock during checkout.
Dynamic PDF Cards: Uses WeasyPrint to compile custom gift cards and message previews into PDFs on the fly.

subsystems.title: 2. Role-Based Admin POS & Order Preparation Dashboard (React & Vite)
subsystems.description: Real-time command center optimized for tablet and desktop viewports, streamlining store operations.
points: Order Preparation Pipeline: Tailored role dashboards (Stock Control prints ingredients, Florists construct bouquets, Delivery Coordinators assign drivers).
Driver Portal: Dedicated hub to manage in-house and third-party delivery dispatching, tracking orders from ready_for_delivery to successfully_delivered.
Dynamic Payment Links: CS agents generate custom payment URLs directly from the POS to secure manual orders.
Batch Operations: Bulk status updates, bulk PDF printing of packaging labels, and batch ingredient checklists.

subsystems.title: 3. Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Storefronts (Next.js Monorepo)
subsystems.description: Performant, modern frontend designed to yield sub-second load times and high conversion rates.
points: Multi-Tenant Routing: Next.js Edge Middleware dynamically routes domains (graftonflowers.com vs crunchyqatar.com) to tenant apps within the PNPM workspace.
Blazing Fast UX: Built utilizing Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) for product and category pages to render static pages from cache, revalidating in background.
Core Web Vitals Optimizations: Leverages next/image for WebP/AVIF formats, next/font for zero CLS, and lazy-loading with code-splitting.

accomplishments: Designed a recipe/ingredients inventory tracking system that dynamically decrements inventory items upon order creation.
Integrated Django Channels and RTK Query cache invalidation, ensuring order updates reflect instantly on Florist preparation monitors.
Configured a PNPM monorepo workspace with shared @monuaf/core packages to eliminate code duplication across brand applications.
Designed custom CSS print rules enabling clean, browser-native printing of physical receipts and packaging labels.
architectureHighlights: Client (Next.js Storefronts / React POS Admin) → Nginx Reverse Proxy → Daphne ASGI Server → Django Core API Engine → PostgreSQL & Redis
Unified multi-tenant monorepo infrastructure powering Grafton Flowers & Crunchy Qatar from a single backend.
Sub-second page rendering with ISR and real-time WebSocket state synchronization.
metrics: Sub-second ISR rendering & real-time role-based POS sync

name: SwimPulse (SwimMetrics)
tagline: High-Precision Swimming Stopwatch, Race Predictor & Offline-First Sync Engine
description: SwimPulse is an all-in-one performance tracking platform built for competitive aquatic sports. Combines a hardware-level monotonic timing engine, official FINA/USA Swimming multi-course conversion algorithms, predictive fatigue stamina decay modeling, an offline-first event mutator queue engine, and RevenueCat in-app subscription monetization.

techLayers.techs: Flutter / Dart (SDK ^3.11), Layered Clean Architecture (presentation, domain, data)
Flutter BLoC (flutter_bloc v9), GetIt (get_it v9), Dartz Monads (dartz v0.10)
Isar DB (isar v3.1 NoSQL), Flutter Secure Storage (v11)

challenges: Monotonic High-Precision Timing Engine: Built using low-level system monotonic clocks (Stopwatch()) to prevent frame drops or timer drift caused by Flutter UI event loop throttling. Includes 150ms hardware debouncing and LIFO stack split undo mechanisms.

Multi-Course Time Converter & Race Predictor: Calculates instant conversions between SCY (25yd), SCM (25m), and LCM (50m) with turn adjustments, block dive offsets (-0.7s), and progressive fatigue stamina decay algorithms.

Offline-First Event Mutator Queue Engine: Writes 100% of lap splits and user flows instantly to local Isar DB. Enqueues event payloads into an immutable SyncQueueEntity synced silently via WorkManager background tasks to Supabase upon network reconnection.

RevenueCat Monetization & Anti-Trial Fraud Guard: Integrated RevenueCat in-app subscriptions ($4.99 / 6-Month Plan) with local CustomerInfo entitlement caching and monotonic hardware clock validation to prevent trial date tampering.

subsystems.title: 1. Hardware-Level Monotonic Timing Engine
subsystems.description: Sub-millisecond accuracy decoupled from UI rendering.
points: Monotonic Accuracy: Uses low-level CPU Stopwatch() to eliminate event-loop timer drift during long timing sessions.
Hardware Debouncing: 150ms debounce handler on split actions preventing accidental double-taps.
LIFO Stack Undo: Immutable split stack allowing coaches to undo accidental split triggers without stopping the clock.
Live Modes: Standard Timer (MM:SS.ms), Live Converter Stopwatch (real-time SCY/SCM/LCM equivalents), and Predictive Stopwatch.

subsystems.title: 2. Multi-Course Converter & Race Predictor
subsystems.description: Empirical course conversion factors and physiological stamina decay modeling.
points: Multi-Course Converter: Converts times between SCY (25 Yards), SCM (25 Meters), and LCM (50 Meters) using FINA/USA Swimming standards.
Race Predictor: Calculates split breakdowns based on stroke type (Free, Back, Breast, Fly), gender, and block dive vs wall push offsets.
Progressive Fatigue Model: Algorithmic calculation simulating physiological stamina decay over long-distance events (400m, 800m, 1500m).

subsystems.title: 3. Offline-First Architecture & Silent Sync Queue Engine
subsystems.description: Zero-latency persistence designed for subterranean concrete pool venues.
points: Zero-Latency Local Storage: All lap splits and user data write directly to thread-safe Isar DB.
Event Mutator Pattern: Action payloads append to immutable SyncQueueEntity marked pending.

Silent Reconciliation via WorkManager: Listens to connectivity streams. When offline, network calls suppress silently; upon reconnect, WorkManager triggers batch syncs to Supabase with exponential backoff.

subsystems.title: 4. RevenueCat Monetization & Anti-Trial Fraud Guard
subsystems.description: Sub-system managing auto-renewable subscriptions and offline entitlement.
points: Freemium Subscriptions: Auto-renewable subscription engine ($4.99 / 6-Month Plan with 7-Day Trial).
Offline Entitlement Caching: Caches CustomerInfo locally for offline premium feature access.
Hardware Clock Guard: Compares encrypted local launch timestamps against hardware monotonic time to block system clock manipulation.

accomplishments: Engineered a monotonic timing engine with software debouncing and LIFO stack split management, eliminating event-loop timer drift.
Implemented an offline-first architecture with Isar DB and an asynchronous Sync Queue Manager leveraging WorkManager and Supabase.
Developed swimming conversion and race prediction engines with progressive fatigue decay algorithms based on FINA/USA Swimming standards.
Integrated RevenueCat in-app subscriptions with offline entitlement caching and hardware clock verification to prevent trial manipulation.
architectureHighlights: User Action → Zero-Latency Isar DB Write → Enqueue SyncQueue Payload → Silent WorkManager Background Sync to Supabase
Layered Clean Architecture strictly separated into presentation/, domain/, and data/ layers.
Sub-millisecond monotonic precision with zero accumulated timer drift.
metrics: Monotonic sub-millisecond precision & silent background sync

name: Mingly
tagline: High-Concurrency SaaS Event Booking & Venue Management
description: High-throughput venue reservation and event ticketing platform engineered to handle massive ticket drop concurrency, distributed locks, complex event recurrence rules, and venue logistics.
challenges: Distributed Atomic Reservation Engine: Architected a booking pipeline using Redis Redlock and atomic database transactions to temporarily lock seats with strict TTLs, eliminating double-bookings.
Recurrent Event Rule Engine: Built a backend scheduling framework supporting complex recurrence patterns, custom blackout dates, and rolling inventory releases.
Integrated Logistics & Check-In Subsystems: Unified ticketing with parking space allocation and encrypted dynamic QR code gate scanning with offline validation.
architectureHighlights: Zero collision ticketing during high-concurrency traffic bursts.
End-to-end venue management unifying ticketing, recurring schedules, and parking allocations.
Live host analytics dashboard streaming real-time seat occupancy and revenue.
metrics: Zero collision ticketing during flash reservation drops

name: CoachCal
tagline: AI-Powered Fitness, Nutrition & Habit Intelligence Platform
description: Intelligent fitness and nutrition companion replacing rigid onboarding forms with a dynamic conversational AI agent and Gemini AI Vision OCR for instant receipt/label macro tracking.
challenges: Conversational AI Onboarding Agent: Replaced 20+ step static forms with a natural chat onboarding workflow gathering metabolic rates, dietary restrictions, and training goals.
Gemini AI Vision OCR Pipeline: Integrated Google Gemini AI multimodal vision API to extract itemized grocery lists from receipts and macro tables directly from product packaging with high precision.
Adaptive Meal Generation Engine: Built a context-aware nutrition planner leveraging LLMs to generate personalized macro-compliant recipes from pantry inventory.
architectureHighlights: Zero-friction profile setup via interactive conversational AI.
Automated Gemini AI vision receipt and label scanning directly into macro databases.
Dynamic meal adaptation adjusting in real time to skipped meals or daily workout intensity.
metrics: Instant Gemini AI vision receipt & label macro extraction

name: RamFollow
description: High-throughput urban mobility platform orchestrating solo ride hailing, on-demand group carpools, fixed-route shuttle networks, and scheduled airport transfers.
challenges: Geospatial Proximity & ETA Dispatch Engine: Built a high-throughput service using Redis Geospatial and PostGIS to query available fleets and match drivers in sub-second latency.
Dynamic Multi-Stop Carpool Clustering: Developed route optimization algorithms clustering passengers along shared transit corridors while strictly capping individual detour delays.
Bi-Directional Telemetry Streaming: Established persistent low-latency WebSockets for real-time driver telemetry streaming, bearing interpolation, and live arrival updates.
architectureHighlights: Multi-tier mobility operations supporting solo, carpool, corporate shuttle, and airport rides.
Sub-second driver matching with turn-by-turn live bearing interpolation.
Automated route optimization with dynamic detour limitation and fare splitting.
metrics: Sub-second driver matching & real-time telemetry streaming

name: Flutter SVG Pro (flutter_svg_pro)
description: Open-source developer library enabling node-level hit testing, tap gesture detection, and dynamic color/border mutations on individual SVG vector paths and XML layers at 60 FPS.
challenges: SVG DOM Decomposition Engine: Built an XML parser converting raw SVG markup into an interactive Dart object tree preserving layer hierarchy, IDs, and path transforms.

Layer-Level Hit Testing & Dynamic Canvas Painting: Engineered a custom canvas renderer with 2D ray-point hit testing, enabling individual vector nodes to listen for pointer events and mutate styles at 60 FPS.
architectureHighlights: Granular node interactivity with tap, hover, and selection listeners on specific SVG paths.
Runtime style mutation allowing dynamic color, opacity, and border updates on the fly.
Zero external dependencies with a lightweight, clean Dart implementation.

name: iMeasure
tagline: Native iOS Augmented Reality Spatial Measurement Tool
description: Zero-latency AR spatial measurement tool leveraging Apple ARKit and SceneKit for real-time frame-by-frame hit testing, live dotted preview tracking, and 3D surface area geometry calculations.
challenges: Continuous Frame-by-Frame Hit-Testing: Implemented real-time raycasting inside the updateAtTime render loop to project a zero-latency live preview line before confirming coordinates.

Multi-Mode 3D Scene Graph: Created 3D anchor nodes supporting Line Mode (3D Euclidean distance), Triangle Mode (3D cross-product perimeter & area), and Quadrilateral Mode (4-point polygon surface area).
Optimized Hardware Lifecycle: Built camera permission gates and node disposal routines to maintain smooth 60 FPS tracking on iOS devices.
architectureHighlights: No-tap live surface tracking with real-time preview line as device moves across surfaces.
Multi-mode geometry calculating linear distance, perimeter, and surface area.
Dual-unit readout in metric (cm) and imperial (ft/in).
metrics: Real-time AR live preview tracking at 60 FPS on iOS

name: Connectify
tagline: Cross-Platform Desktop Utility for Wireless ADB
description: Cross-platform desktop GUI abstracting Android Debug Bridge (ADB) terminal commands into one-click wireless pairing, APK drag-and-drop sideloading, screen mirroring, and logcat filtering.
challenges: GUI-Driven ADB Abstraction Layer: Developed a desktop UI abstracting complex command-line workflows behind one-click graphical controls.
Automated Device Pairing & TCP/IP Discovery: Built automated network discovery and wireless pairing routines via IP/port and QR code pairing without opening a terminal.
Streamlined QA Tooling Suite: Integrated APK drag-and-drop installation, real-time screen mirroring, and logcat filtering with instant log export.
architectureHighlights: Zero-terminal setup enabling non-technical stakeholders (QA, PMs) to manage devices.
Instant wireless debugging eliminating physical USB cable constraints.
Lightweight memory footprint compared to full Android Studio IDE instances.
metrics: One-click wireless ADB pairing & zero-terminal setup

name: Hisaboto
tagline: Enterprise Financial Management & Field Reconciliation Suite
description: Offline-first financial ledger suite for field collection agents, enabling encrypted local transaction recording, digital proof of collection receipts, and automated batch synchronization.
challenges: Offline-First Secure Transaction Vault: Architected a local-first encrypted database allowing field agents to record collections and balance ledgers without network connection.
Conflict-Free Synchronization Pipeline: Developed a background sync engine batching offline ledgers and pushing to central servers with automated timestamp reconciliation.
Role-Based Financial Audit Trails: Built multi-tier permission controls, end-of-day cash reconciliation sheets, and automated discrepancy reporting.
architectureHighlights: 100% offline operational continuity for field agents in remote regions.
Automated batch reconciliation with zero data loss upon network recovery.
Tamper-evident digital proof of collection receipts generated on-device.
metrics: 100% offline operational continuity & zero data loss sync

name: Country Names (country_names)
tagline: Zero-Dependency ISO-3166 Country & Dial Code Library
description: Ultra-lightweight, tree-shakeable Dart package providing instant O(1) constant-time lookup for ISO-3166 country codes, international dial codes, and localized country names.
challenges: Zero-Dependency Lookup Engine: Built a tree-shakeable package containing normalized ISO-3166 datasets (Alpha-2, Alpha-3, Numeric) and international dialing codes.
Optimized In-Memory Indexing: Structured country records with constant-time O(1) hash maps for instant dial code and country code lookup during user typing.
architectureHighlights: Ultra-lightweight footprint with zero external dependencies and tree-shakeable assets.
Instant O(1) query performance for international dial codes during real-time typing.
Plug-and-play API designed for Flutter form validation and country pickers.
